blocks.text: The Linked Services page shows your subscribed Zscaler service tenants. If a tenant is unlinked, the users under that tenant can't access the Zscaler Admin Console.
Service linking provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Individually view your organization-level access to Zscaler Admin Console via Authentication Service.
Get a clear idea of Authentication Service enablement status for your organization.

blocks.text: On the Linked Services page (Administration > Account Management > Linked Services), you can:

blocks.item: View a list of tenants. For each tenant, you can see:
Product: The name of the Zscaler service.
Tenant ID: The tenant ID of the Zscaler service.
Cloud Name: The name of the Zscaler cloud on which the Zscaler service is used.
Organization Name: The name of the tenant organization.
Authentication Service Migration Status: Whether the tenant has been migrated fully to Authentication Service.
Status: Whether the tenant is linked or unlinked from Authentication Service.
Refresh the page to sync any new data.
